images.raw_map_hash_scope: Existing register_map_sha256 and flash_map_sha256 identify the final raw files.
images.map_stability_definition: CSR non-comment records equal byte for byte; flash-map JSON objects equal after excluding only source metadata. Raw files differ and their hashes are preserved.
images.normalized_hash_encoding: CSR: retain non-comment split lines, join with LF and one final LF. Flash map: sorted-key compact JSON, UTF-8, no final LF.
